name: World map facts
notes: Facts the world connectivity map (src/content/data/world/connectivity.json, mw-e24.1) reads to open shortcuts and gates. Each is written by the level bead named in its description; until that content is placed the world validator warns the fact is unproduced.

facts.description: The boarded Deepworks main gate is open: Vane's key used, the boarding smashed, the winch cage dropped, the bar lifted or the padlock picked (bible 4.1 beat 5). Written by the gate puzzle (mw-e25.10); read by the world map edge mine-gate-winch.
The loose ladder-rung under the Glen Well is pulled and the cistern route is open (mw-e24.10).
The jail cell drain grate is open and the cistern route is usable from the cell (mw-e24.8).
The Hornfolk seal on the stone door in the east wall of Horn's Hall is dispelled and the secret route to the Cradle is open (mw-e26.10 greybox; the fragments and the dispel are a follow-up bead).
The collapse in Mooring's Watch supply tunnel is cleared (mw-e25.9).
The Millweir sluice walk is passable to the Briarwood far bank (mw-e25.12).
A climber has entered Vane House by its roof (mw-e24.9, mw-e24.12).
The Sleepers' Path is revealed, by night or by a tracker's eye (mw-e25.2).
The flooded Weeping Adit has a way up into the lower Deepworks: raft moored, current crossed or barge winched (mw-e25.13).
The Stone Stair is lowered from the cutting hall so it can be taken down to the quay (mw-e25.11).
The priory crypt seal is broken from the Knot side (mw-e26.20).
The Drowned Gull trapdoor to the Undertow is found (mw-e40.12).
The Net Lofts rooftop route onto the Customs House is climbed (mw-e40.13).
